Our Facilities

Thoughtfully designed for every stage.

Bright, safe and inspiring spaces where children can learn, explore and be themselves.

Welcoming Reception

A warm and friendly space for parents and children to begin their TLA journey.

Active Play Area

Indoor play designed to build confidence, creativity and physical development.

Creative Learning Spaces

Flexible spaces for reading, art, STEM and co-curricular activities.

What Makes Us Different

More than an after-school program.

A few things you won't find in a typical daycare or after-school setup.

First in Islamabad

10×10 ft LEGO Wall

A floor-to-ceiling build wall where kids create at a scale they've never had before — the first of its kind in Islamabad.

Sensory Play Walls

Textured panels built for hands-on exploration — calming for some children, exciting for others, good for every child.

Book Reading Corners

Cozy, beautifully designed nooks tucked around the space, made for getting lost in a good book.

Prayer Room & Qur'an Classes

An exclusive, dedicated prayer room with guided prayer training and Qur'an classes woven into the week.

Smart Interactive Classrooms

85" interactive touchscreens power every classroom. Each lecture is QR-coded — scan it and the day's lesson is emailed straight to you.

Fully CCTV-Monitored

Every corner of the facility is under camera coverage, so safety is never something you have to wonder about.

Trained, Experienced Staff

Our team is trained specifically for activities, changing and washroom support — led by highly experienced teachers, not just supervisors.

Islamabad's Largest Wooden Toy Collection

An extensive inventory of wooden interactive toys fills the play area — built to last, made to be touched, stacked and reinvented.

Our Approach

Learning that feels like play.

We believe children learn best when they feel safe, curious and engaged. Our approach blends guided learning with exploration, creativity and meaningful play.

1

Project-based learning

Children solve real problems through making, testing, presenting and reflecting.

2

Learning through play

Purposeful play develops social, cognitive and emotional skills without making learning feel like school.

3

Small-group coaching

Educators give focused help for homework, reading and individual learning goals.

4

Whole-child development

Movement, creativity, confidence, independence and kindness matter as much as academics.

A Day at the Atelier

A thoughtful rhythm, from arrival to pickup.

Arrival & reset

Snack, connection and time to transition from the school day.

Focus time

Homework, reading and small-group academic coaching.

Create & discover

Daily rotating studios: science, art, making, cooking and more.

Move & play

Active games, outdoor-style movement and social play.

Life skills

Responsibility, independence, practical skills and healthy routines.

Parent handover

Clear updates so families know how the afternoon went.

Designed for Working Parents, Too

Peace of mind is part of the program.

  • Secure check-in & pickup
  • Attentive educator supervision
  • Transparent parent communication
  • Calm, clean and welcoming spaces
